title: Gas Vent Dampers Recalled by Effikal Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The automatic gas vent damper could fail, and if the blocked vent switch does not activate, the vent could leak carbon monoxide (CO). This poses a risk of CO poisoning to consumers. Units: About 45,000.

title: Hasbro Inc. Recalls to Repair Nerf Blasters; Child's Skin Can Get Caught in Plunger of the Toy
summary: The blaster's plunger can pull the user's skin during firing of the toy blaster resulting in injury to the face, neck, and/or chest. Units: About 330,000 units.

title: Coby Electronics Recalls Rechargeable Batteries Sold with Portable DVD/CD/MP3 Players Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rechargeable batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC and Chance Rides Manufacturing Announce Recall to Inspect and Repair YO-YO Amusement Rides
summary: The sweep arms suspending the riding chairs can broke free from the ride's center cylinder rod, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 85.

title: Outdoor Playset Gliders Recalled by Backyard Play Systems Due to Fall Hazard; New Assembly Instructions Provided
summary: Some of the gliders were shipped with assembly instructions that did not inform consumers to tighten all lock nuts during assembly, including those attached by the manufacturer. As a result, some lock nuts were not fully fastened during assembly which could cause the glider to detach, posing a fall

title: Rack Room Shoes Recalls Girls' Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The ornamental flowers on the sandals can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 11,000.

title: Children's Necklaces, CD and MP3 Players Sold at Limited Too and Justice Stores Recalled by Tween Brands Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface coatings on these products could contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 12,000.

title: Game Chairs Recalled by Brunswick Bowling & Billiards Corp. Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The retaining washers on the legs can loosen, causing the chair to become unstable. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: John Jaques & Son Recalls Lawn Dart Games Due to Risk of Puncture
summary: The darts in the games pose a puncture hazard to young children. Lawn darts were banned in December 1988 to protect children from skull, face and eye puncture wounds. Units: About 35.

title: Viessmann U.S. Recalls Boilers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The boiler can leak gas, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,600.

title: BRP U.S. Inc. Recalls Youth All Terrain Vehicles Due to Collision Hazard
summary: If the rider is ejected and the cord strap is pulled, the shutoff switch can fail to disable the engine. The ATV can operate uncontrolled, until the engine returns to idle, and cause a collision with bystanders, vehicles or other objects. This poses a serious risk of injury. Units: About 1,200.

title: Pottery Barn Recalls Wooden Hammock Stands Due to Fall and Laceration Hazard
summary: When used outdoors, the wood in the hammock stand can deteriorate over time and break, posing a risk of falls and lacerations to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: Gaming System Batteries and Recharging Station Recalled by LeapFrog Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The rechargeable batteries included with the Recharging Station can overheat if the gaming system is placed into the recharging base upside down, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 35,500.

title: Murray Riding Lawn Mowers Recalled By Briggs & Stratton Power Products Group Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The two-piece fuel tanks on the riding mowers can separate at the seam, causing fuel to leak. This can pose fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,100.

title: Shimano American Corp. Recalls Wheels for Bicycles; Flat Tire Can Pose Injury Risk to Riders
summary: Rim surface and spoke hole plugs on the wheel can cause a puncture to the inner tube, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 275.

title: YMCA Trading Recalls Lighters Due to Potential Burn Hazard to Children
summary: The multi-purpose lighters fail to meet federal safety standards because they might not contain a child-resistant mechanism, posing a potential fire and burn hazard to young children. Units: About 24,000.

title: Fiesta Recalls to Inspect and Repair Gas Grills Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The gas grills can be assembled improperly exposing the gas burner hoses to excessive heat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 47,000.

title: Rage Wireless Guitars Used with Popular Video Gaming System Recalled Due to Chemical Burn Risk
summary: A circuit board defect can cause AA batteries used in the guitar to leak if the batteries are installed incorrectly, posing a risk of chemical burns to consumers. Units: About 57,000.

title: Infant Death Prompts Recall To Repair 600,000 Drop Side Cribs By Delta Enterprise; Spring Peg Failure Can Cause Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The crib's drop side can detach when the spring peg is not engaged, which can cause an entrapment and suffocation risk to infants and toddlers. If the spring pegs in the base of each leg of the crib are pushed back into the lower track, the pegs can become nonfunctional. This can cause the drop side

title: Infant Death Prompts Recall to Repair 985,000 Delta Enterprise Drop Side Cribs; Missing Safety Pegs Can Cause Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: When the safety pegs in the base of each leg of the crib are missing from the lower track, the crib locks can disengage and detach if lowered below the peg hole, creating a hazardous gap. This gap can lead to the entrapment and suffocation of an infant or toddler. Units: About 985,000.

title: Infant Death Prompts Recall of Convertible Cribs by Playkids USA; Crib Poses Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The sides of the convertible crib are made of a mesh that expands, creating a gap between the mattress and the side through which an infant can slip. This poses suffocation and entrapment hazards for young children. Units: About 2,000.

title: My Way Corp. Recalls Baby Walkers Due to Stairway Fall Hazard
summary: The walkers violate the baby walker voluntary standard and can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed. Units: About 800.

title: Fujifilm Recalls Battery Chargers Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The plastic portion of the unit's power plug can crack or detach, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,300.

title: Toy Boats Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The two battery terminals can come into contact with each other, causing the battery to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000.

title: Bar Magnets Recalled by Home Science Tools Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the magnets contain excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 400.

title: Portable Generators Recalled by General Power Products Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The generator's fuel valve can be damaged by the cover plate during shipment and cause a fuel leak and fuel spillage during use, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: Wireless Headset Batteries Recalled by GN Netcom Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal short circuit in the lithium-ion polymer batteries can cause the batteries to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 525,000 (an additional 675,000 were sold outside the U.S.).

title: DYMO Recalls Power Adapters Sold with DYMO Printers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The power adapters can fail, causing the printer to overheat. This can pose a burn hazard to consumers. Units: 17000.

title: Fit & Fresh Mixers Recalled by MEDport LLC Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: While placing the cup on or off the base of the mixer, the mixer can be unexpectedly turned on, activating the blade. This can pose a serious laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 54,500.

title: Homelite Consumer Products Announce Recall to Repair Chain Saws Due to Chain Brake Failure
summary: The chain brake can fail to stop the chain on its first application, posing a risk of laceration to consumers. Units: About 370,000.

title: PC Notebook Computer Batteries Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 35,000 batteries (an additional 65,000 batteries were sold worldwide).

title: Wooden Toys Recalled by Earth Friendly Due To Choking Hazards
summary: Small parts can detach and break from the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. In addition, the size of the rattle handle violates voluntary rattle standards. Units: About 1,000.

title: Cybex International Recalls Treadmills Due to Fall Hazard; Can Speed Up Unexpectedly
summary: The treadmills can speed up unexpectedly while in use due to a malfunction with the lower control board, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 19,000.

title: Ghost Tealight Holders Recalled by Trade Associates Group and Crate & Barrel Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled tealight holder can ignite posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: Halloween Figurines Recalled by Coyne's & Company for Lead Hazard
summary: The recalled Halloween figurines contain high levels of lead in the paint. Units: About 14,000.

title: Power Adapters Used with Notebook Computers Recalled by Battery-Biz Due To Burn Hazard
summary: The adapters can fail and overheat. This can pose a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,300.

title: Serta International Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,100.
